w152 is done, and its one scenario, supervision#r69, now passes.

The scenario only failed because its second Given had no step definition. I added that one binding in `tests/scenarios/supervision_rounds_steps.py`. The production code already moved the proposal to awaiting-answer, so nothing else changed.

- **Red run:** `python3 -m pytest -q --work-item w152` gave 1 failed, 142 passed, failing at that undefined Given.
- **Green run:** the same command gave 143 passed, 1 skipped. I also ran `tests/scenarios/test_supervision.py` on its own and it passed.
- **Size check:** `tools size --limit 300` printed nothing, so no file is over the limit.

The scenario is silent on a gate that gives zero questions, a PARTIAL gate result, `work run`'s exit when only a proposal is waiting, and `model check` rejecting `awaiting-answer`. It also says nothing about a failure between the move and the questions write. I left all of these unchosen and listed them in the report.

The plan contained no code. One commit: `c5a7bb1`. The result file says `DONE`, and the report is `.shop/scratch/3-implement/report.md`.
